title: SSCard: Substring Cardinality Estimation using Suffix Tree-Guided Learned FM-Index

statements.text: Starting character in estimation. Given a pattern string $P$ and a pruned suffix tree $T$, a char $P[i](1≤ i ≤ |P|)$ is the starting character, if the suffix started from $P[i]$ matches a path in $T$, and no suffix started from $P[k](k<i)$ matches any path in $T$.
the $i$-th $L$-triple. Given the $L$-array in BWT. The $i$-th $L$-triple takes the form of $(L[i],i, r)$, where $r$ is the rank (i.e., the number of prior occurrences) of $L[i]$ in the $L$-array.
